payload.name: pc-transfer-11
payload.description: Pure-logic rank classifier. Reads a raw rank candidate and returns {kind, rank}: 'missing' when the key is absent, 'null' when present but null, 'integer' when it is an exact integer in 7..16 (inclusive), otherwise 'invalid'. No coercion, defaults, exceptions, imports, I/O or host calls. Unapproved draft; typed-input transport and Monty execution are target interfaces requiring runner support.
